description: DR Failover Runbook — ap-south-1 (Mumbai) to ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)

LambdaFunctionName.description: Lambda function that orchestrates the failover

AutomationAssumeRole.description: IAM role ARN for SSM Automation to assume

mainSteps.name: VerifyPrimaryIsDown
mainSteps.description: Confirm the primary alarm is in ALARM state before proceeding

mainSteps.name: TriggerLambdaFailover
mainSteps.description: Invoke Lambda to promote RDS replica and scale DR ASG

mainSteps.name: WaitForASGInstancesToStart
mainSteps.description: Wait 3 minutes for DR EC2 instances to come up and pass health checks

mainSteps.name: VerifyDRASGHealthy
mainSteps.description: Confirm at least one healthy instance in DR ASG

mainSteps.name: WaitForRDSPromotion
mainSteps.description: Poll RDS every 30s until replica is promoted to standalone (up to 10 minutes)
